description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Modaxso Drarinmo)
- Vendor B (Sodax Kethoquo)
- Vendor C (Yerbre Sotiroz)
- Vendor D (Mohesk Talrin)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Modaxso Drarinmo):
  - Vendor A has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor A has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor A has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor A has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor A currently serves 4 hospital clients
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 5 months
Vendor B (Sodax Kethoquo):
  - Vendor B offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor B failed a recent security audit
  - Vendor B has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor B performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 5 months
Vendor C (Yerbre Sotiroz):
  - Vendor C uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor C allows workflow customisation
  - Vendor C keeps backups only on-site
  - Vendor C completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C estimates deployment will take 4 months
Vendor D (Mohesk Talrin):
  - Vendor D allows no customisation
  - Vendor D offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor D imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor D supports standard interoperability formats
  - Vendor D reported 1 major outages last year
